output.patientMessage: You can start with sleep-habit steps now: consistent bed and wake times, avoiding caffeine in the afternoon and evening, no screens in bed, and getting up to do something relaxing if you can't fall asleep after about 20 minutes. Stress-related sleep-onset trouble often responds to this. Message us if sleep stays poor after a few weeks, if you feel low or hopeless, or if you feel drowsy while driving.
